_readme.purpose: Voice registry for MSF Qwen3-TTS cloning. Each voice = reference audio + verbatim transcript.
_readme.mode: ICL (prosody transfer) requires ref_text. Without ref_text the engine falls back to x-vector mode (timbre only, flatter delivery).
_readme.ref_text_rule: ref_text must be the EXACT words spoken in ref_audio, and must not run past the end of the clip. A transcript longer than the audio triggers truncated output.
_readme.length_rule: MEASURED: a 30 s reference produced 0.87 s of audio against a 5.20 s x-vector baseline (truncated). An 8 s reference produced 3.75 s vs a 4.23 s baseline (healthy). Keep references at 8-15 s.
_readme.format_rule: 24 kHz mono is native for Qwen3. 48 kHz works but is resampled internally.
_readme.source_rule: Use a HUMAN recording. Cloning from TTS output compounds vocoder artifacts. Tell them apart by noise floor: a live mic sits around -40 dB, synthetic output around -80 dB (digital silence in the gaps).

syenduk.ref_text: Кому бы не хотелось поговорить с животными, Рик? Большинство людей.
syenduk.notes: Live human speech, trimmed to 8 s and resampled to 24 kHz mono. Verified working in ICL mode (3.75 s output vs 4.23 s x-vector baseline). Default voice.

syenduk_30s_raw.ref_text: Кому бы не хотелось поговорить с животными, Рик? Большинство людей. А, оттого, только поаккуратнее там. Надо двигаться без конца. Верх вниз, вниз, вверх, вниз, вверх, стоп вниз. Матке нужна еда. Деткам нужна еда. Матка рожает деток.
syenduk_30s_raw.notes: BROKEN FOR ICL — 30 s is too long, output truncates to 0.87 s. Kept only as the source for trimming. Do not select for rendering.

clone_test_10s.ref_text: Ищите лучшие оупен сорс решения в области искусственного интеллекта? Канал ЛЛМ Хабс — ваш главный источник передовых нейросетей.
clone_test_10s.notes: This is TTS OUTPUT, not a human recording (noise floor -80.8 dB). Cloning from it recycles vocoder artifacts. Kept for A/B comparison only.
